rules: Identify the strongest hooks, emotional angles, zodiac topics, script structures, video lengths, posting slots and CTA patterns from the previous full week.
Identify weak patterns and reduce their use unless they are deliberate experiments.
Use successful mechanisms as inspiration but never copy an old script, hook, punchline or near-duplicate concept.
Prefer evidence from retention, shares and saves over likes alone when those metrics are available.
Do not overfit to one viral outlier; look for repeated patterns across multiple posts and platforms.
If data is insufficient, keep the existing strategy and continue testing rather than inventing conclusions.
